_note: Low-direct-competition, high-adjacent-demand world-rule premises. Scores are updated by src/self_improve.py.

topics.title: The Lost Property Office
topics.hook: In this town, the lost-and-found office is never empty. Whatever you leave there comes back the next morning with a note in someone else's handwriting.

topics.title: Library of Unfinished Letters
topics.hook: In this library, every unfinished letter is returned answered. Nobody remembers writing the replies.

topics.title: The Umbrella Stand
topics.hook: In this town, an umbrella appears at the school door for every storm that never happened.

topics.title: Your Shadow Leaves First
topics.hook: In this town, your shadow clocks in before you do. Every morning at 7:03 it takes its place in line.

topics.title: The Ticket Window
topics.hook: In this station, the ticket seller sells seats to places that do not exist yet.

topics.title: The Second Bell
topics.hook: In this school, the second bell rings for the students who are not in the room.

topics.title: The Weather Lender
topics.hook: In this town you can borrow tomorrow's weather, but you must return it exactly as you found it.
